criteria.title: Validate complete boot-tag and memory-map spans before interpreting fields.
criteria.task: Implement the tag walker with total-size and offset bounds checked before reading size or rounding. Test size7/8/21, truncated size fields, unknown tags and larger mmap stride; preserve a cursor ledger.
